newsitem.title: USA: CBOT inflation note futures see thin initial trade.
newsitem.headline: CBOT inflation note futures see thin initial trade.

text.p: Only a handful of inflation-protected 10-year Treasury futures traded on the contract's opening day, the Chicago Board of Trade said.

The CBOT Thursday launched futures and options on both five- and 10-year inflation-indexed Treasurys, but just five of the 10-year contracts traded and none of the five-year instruments, the CBOT said. No options traded on either contract, it said.
"We expect to see more volume as the contract matures," a CBOT spokeswoman said.
